evidence: Coordinator authorizes a minimal generic source-model repair driven by this reproduced recovery blocker, not a new CLI, compiler policy or acceptance waiver. Support only an explicitly related direct bounded parent plus one unbounded v3 first-member identity at the same original start, same TU and image/address domain. Require parent emitted-symbol equality with child.parent_symbol, preserve independent historical symbols/interpretations and all existing source annotations.

Keep unrelated same-start roots/children, multiple first-member aliases, missing bounded parent, wrong owner/unit/domain, bounded overlap and target-alias roots refused. Share narrow validation between reader/writer rather than drifting policies; do not modify binary comparators, object_targets layout checks or compiler flags to accept unknowns.

Add positive reader/writer round-trip tests in both insertion orders, negative duplicate/collision/ownership/bounds cases, and native synthetic CodeView target/data controls showing offset-zero can pass while a nonzero actual first-member offset, missing types or conflicting base refuses. Existing full package tests and fresh real debug-enabled native data trials must pass for selected source annotations; missing Release types remain UNKNOWN.

Only listed library/test/format files plus already authorized src/map.cpp may change. Use apply_patch; Python via uv run. Worker authors source and pure tests but runs no tests/native compiler/Wine/Git/task operations. Coordinator owns fresh test execution, independent implementation review, data/compiler verification and serial manual integration with explicit remaining limitations. No historical claim/state/baseline changes.
